response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(length AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_length, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS DOUBLE) / CAST(replacement_cost AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per_rating;
